themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across multiple countries are intensifying anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, often framing immigration as a national security and economic threat. This theme appears prominently in the U.S., Italy, Germany, and the UK, with leaders proposing stricter border controls, visa revocations, and prioritization of native-born citizens in social programs.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes mass visa revocations for asylum seekers and threatens tariffs on Canadian goods over immigration disputes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for stricter migrant detention policies and externalization of border controls, facing opposition from regional governments.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Pushes for Schengen exit, deportation of Syrian refugees, and stricter border controls, citing migration as a top electoral issue.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes evicting foreign nationals from social housing and prioritizing British-born citizens in welfare and housing policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes government handling of migrant minors in Ceuta and demands stricter border enforcement.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration policies and opposes welfare benefits for asylum seekers.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders seek re-election amid economic controversies
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders in Argentina, Italy, the U.S., and Poland are navigating re-election campaigns amid economic controversies, including inflation, debt crises, and trade disputes. These leaders often frame economic challenges as external threats or necessary sacrifices for long-term stability, while facing criticism from opposition parties and voters.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei faces declining approval amid rising debt and inflation, while pushing unpopular economic reforms and defending his policies as necessary for long-term stability.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni seeks re-election amid economic struggles, including high energy prices and slow reconstruction efforts, while facing criticism over her government's handling of inflation and public debt.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump campaigns for re-election amid economic tensions with Canada, proposing tariffs and framing trade disputes as necessary to protect American industries.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces declining support amid economic controversies, including inflation and public debt, while proposing tax reforms to appeal to voters.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's new government under Péter Magyar faces economic challenges, including inflation and budget deficits, while navigating EU funding disputes.

themes.title: Internal divisions challenge right-wing party unity
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Poland, the UK, Argentina, and Hungary are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional disputes. These divisions often revolve around ideological differences, personal rivalries, or disagreements over electoral strategies, threatening party cohesion and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Faces internal tensions over leadership and policy direction, with Salvini's Lega struggling to maintain influence amid rising competition from Vannacci's faction.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Experiences factional splits, with key members leaving to form rival groups like Rozwój Plus, amid leadership disputes and corruption scandals.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Struggles with internal divisions over leadership and policy direction, with members suspended for criticizing party leadership.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Faces internal conflicts over electoral strategies and policy priorities, with factions competing for influence within the party.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Experiences internal splits as former members form new factions, challenging Orbán's leadership and party cohesion.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Sweden, France, the UK, and Spain are making significant gains in regional and national polls, often capitalizing on voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties. These gains are driven by anti-immigration rhetoric, economic anxieties, and opposition to EU policies, positioning far-right parties as viable alternatives in upcoming elections.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and other eastern states, with growing support driven by anti-immigration and anti-EU rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Gains traction in Swedish polls, positioning itself as a key player in the upcoming election and advocating for stricter immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen leads French presidential polls, with far-right policies gaining mainstream acceptance amid economic and social discontent.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Makes gains in local elections and polls, challenging the Conservative Party and pushing anti-immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains influence in regional governments, particularly in Castilla y León, by forming coalitions with the PP and advocating for nationalist policies.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, the U.S., the UK, Hungary, and Spain are targeting social programs as part of broader fiscal debates, often justifying cuts as necessary for economic stability. These policies face criticism from opposition parties and civil society groups, who argue they disproportionately harm vulnerable populations.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Proposes cuts to social programs, including disability benefits and public sector wages, amid fiscal austerity measures and rising debt.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Targets student loan programs and healthcare subsidies, framing cuts as necessary to reduce government spending and debt.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for cuts to social housing and welfare benefits, prioritizing British-born citizens and veterans in housing allocation.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Implements fiscal austerity measures, including cuts to public sector wages and social programs, amid budget deficits and EU funding disputes.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes government spending on social programs, advocating for fiscal restraint and prioritization of national interests.
